verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at cursor.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the documentation as markdown links. A markdown version of the Bugbot docs is served at cursor.com/docs/bugbot.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation advertising or describing the llms.txt and markdown docs for agents, confirmation that the Cursor-wide llms.txt explicitly lists the Bugbot pages, and independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
